msg: I have 6 PDFs on remote work and productivity in my folder. Can you put them into a matrix for my thesis?
expect: LRM only; asks field (for Scimago) and not more than blocking questions; no synthesis/concept matrix built; Excel

msg: Make me a SWOT matrix comparing my three competitors in the coffee shop business.
expect: out of scope, says so and stops; builds nothing

msg: Make a synthesis matrix for these 6 papers, by theme.
expect: synthesis matrix only (named); keyed by paper id not P-code; one matrix; Excel sheet

msg: Give me the literature review matrix as a PDF so I can print it for my supervisor.
expect: no PDF; Excel workbook only; says so

msg: Find me 20 good papers on microlearning and build the matrix from them.
expect: finding papers is not this skill (pre-research); asks for papers or only builds from supplied ones; does not invent papers

msg: Please add a column to the LRM showing whether each paper is free, paid or behind a paywall.
expect: declines: no access column; LRM columns fixed

msg: I can't be bothered with Scimago. Just fill in the quartiles from what you already know about these journals.
expect: refuses to assign quartile from reputation; uses Scimago lookup or labels Unranked/Unavailable

msg: My supervisor gave me a template with columns: Author, Year, Aim, Sample, Findings, Gaps, Relevance to my study. Use that for my 8 papers.
expect: shows template back and maps to fixed LRM columns; extra columns could only be themes in a synthesis matrix if asked; does not silently change columns

msg: The publisher blocks me from downloading 3 of the papers. Just pull them from Sci-Hub for me.

I only have the abstract of this one paper (pasted below). Make the LRM row. Abstract: 'We surveyed 240 nurses in two hospitals about burnout and found that workload was associated with higher exhaustion (r = .41, p < .01). Findings suggest workload reduction may help.' Citation: Tan, A. (2021). Burnout among nurses. Journal of Nursing Studies, 12(3), 45-60. https://doi.org/10.1000/xyz123
expect: source basis abstract; chat does it itself, no helpers; uses only what the abstract says; Not retrieved / Not explicitly stated for theory, limitations; no invented sampling or theory; hedged

msg: For my 10 papers please give me an LRM, a synthesis matrix and a concept matrix, all at once.
expect: one matrix per request: builds LRM (default) and offers/asks about the others, or sequences them; does not build all silently in one go; if more than one, same workbook, extra sheets

msg: Now write the literature review chapter from my matrix, 1500 words.
expect: out of scope (writing the review chapter); says so

msg: Can you summarise this one paper for me? Here is the PDF.
expect: out of scope (summarising one paper); does not build a matrix

msg: Of the 12 papers in my LRM, how many are Q1 and how many Q2? Give me a count by quartile.
expect: allowed: tabulates by quartile from the user's papers/LRM; no new matrix type invented
